'''Finvarra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Nyriaanan]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. When Finvarra was 16, a group of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] agents traveled to Nyriaan to investigate the [[Deluge Experiment]], and they hired Finvarra to act as a guide for them.
